sections.title: 1388 1332023 [HTT 4 (T) No.B-7473 Jabalpur,the 11 October 2023 In exercise of...
sections.text: 1388 1332023 [HTT 4 (T) No.B-7473 Jabalpur,the 11 October 2023 In exercise of the powers conferred by article 227 of the Constitution of India read with section 122 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908) and section 23 of the Madhya Pradesh Civil Courts Act, 1958 (No.19 of 1958), the High Court of Madhya Pradesh, hereby, makes the following amendment in the Madhya Pradesh Civil Courts Rules, 1961, Namely :- AMENDMENT In the said rules, in chapter XXX, in rule 594-A, for sub-rule (28), the following sub-rule shall be substituted, namely : - "(28) The maximum chargeable rate shall be Rs. 25/- per page for computer typing and Rs. 20/- per page for manual typing, as the case may be, subject to maximum limit of Rs.1000/- (in case of computer typing) and Rs. 800/- (in case of manual typing) on a petition or other document." RAMKUMAR CHOUBEY, Registrar General.

The maximum chargeable rate shall be Rs. 25/- per page for computer typing and Rs. 20/- per page for manual typing, as the case may be, subject to maximum limit of Rs.1000/- (in case of computer typing) and Rs. 800/- (in case of manual typing) on a petition or other document." RAMKUMAR CHOUBEY,RegistrarGeneral.
